entries.text: Added Local Proxy mode with configurable SOCKS5 and HTTP listeners, so selected apps can use the VPN without changing system routes or DNS.
entries.reason: The service runs gpclient in tunnel mode; NetworkManager owns routes and DNS. Local Proxy mode is a gpservice/GUI flow that we do not use.

entries.text: Added a gateway IP preference for trying IPv4 or IPv6 first, available in Settings and through `gpclient connect --ip-preference`.
entries.reason: The default of --ip-preference is auto, which keeps the previous address resolution. The service does not pass the flag. The help text of --disable-ipv6 changed too; the service does not pass that flag either.

entries.text: Enabled switching between the macOS main window and menu bar popover without restarting the app.
entries.reason: GUI only, macOS only.

entries.text: Refined gateway selection, connection status, and proxy listener details.
entries.reason: The gateway list, the Select prompt and the chosen-gateway lines that the service reads are unchanged: contract items gateway-count, gateway-chosen-*, gateway-select-prompt and code-connect-portal are OK on v3.2.0.

entries.text: Made numeric settings validation clearer before saving.
entries.reason: GUI only: settings of gpgui.

entries.text: Fixed VPN shutdown waiting too long when a gateway stops responding to logout.
entries.reason: The fix is in the bundled openconnect (logout watchdog). gpclient disconnect and the exit on SIGTERM are unchanged; the service still waits for the logout and kills after its own timeout.

entries.text: Fixed segmented controls sometimes losing the selected option when clicked.
entries.reason: GUI only.

entries.text: Fixed app shortcuts failing to open with some Linux and BSD desktop launchers.
entries.reason: GUI shortcuts of gpgui. The desktop file that we install is unchanged (contract item desktop-exec is OK).

entries.text: Added a Connection Details panel showing VPN information and live upload and download activity.
entries.reason: The panel is GUI only. The service reads the matching CLI log lines (VPN interface, DNS, search domains, split DNS, MTU) as a cross-check and a fallback for the DNS state of the vpnc hook, never for routing (issue 37).

entries.text: Added an optional terminal dashboard showing connection status and logs, enabled with `--dashboard`.
entries.reason: The service relies on text output, a foreground process and its own browser wrapper: it never passes --dashboard.

entries.text: Added client certificate setup in Settings, with guidance when a VPN requires a certificate.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Client certificate setup is in the GUI.

entries.text: Refreshed Settings and dialogs, with automatic saving for most settings and Save and Cancel buttons for detailed edits.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Settings and dialogs.

entries.text: Made sign-in errors clearer and added recovery options within the app.
entries.reason: Error texts of the GUI and recovery options in the app. The only error text we parse (legacy TLS renegotiation) is guarded by contract items tls-legacy-* and code-tls-classifier.

entries.text: Added a website address bar to the sign-in window.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. The sign-in window with an address bar is the embedded browser; the service uses its own browser wrapper.

entries.text: Expanded support for client certificate files, including password-protected files, with clearer file and password errors.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Client certificate files are set in the GUI.

entries.text: Improved license activation error messages and troubleshooting logs.
entries.reason: License activation is a GUI feature (gpgui).

entries.text: Fixed sign-in retries losing the selected VPN server after a security error.
entries.reason: Retry logic inside the upstream sign-in flow after a security error; the interface we use does not change. The flow code is guarded by contract item code-connect-portal.

entries.text: Fixed mismatched certificate and key files being accepted and replacing a working certificate setup.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Certificate setup in Settings.

entries.text: Fixed failed saves discarding certificate details or custom device report (HIP) edits, allowing a retry without re-entering changes.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Saving of certificate and HIP settings.

entries.text: Fixed theme, automatic-update, and logging settings appearing saved when saving had failed; errors are now shown and previous settings remain in use.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Settings.

entries.text: Fixed notifications disappearing too quickly on GNOME and clarified notification sender names and update titles.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Desktop notifications.

entries.text: Fixed connection failures with some VPN gateways.
entries.reason: Upstream-internal fix for some gateways. It does not change the interface or the text we use.

entries.text: Renamed copy-and-paste browser sign-in to `--browser manual`; existing commands using `--browser remote` still work.
entries.reason: The service relies on text output, a foreground process and its own browser wrapper: it never passes --browser manual or remote.

entries.text: Removed the unneeded `--fix-openssl` option on macOS; existing macOS commands and scripts must omit it.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu.

entries.text: Added adaptive macOS app icons for light and dark appearances.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu. App icons.

entries.text: Fixed macOS browser sign-in by automatically selecting the installed callback handler.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu.

entries.text: Improved app icon proportions in Finder and across the app, installer, and website.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. App icons, installer and website.

entries.text: Added `gpclient connect --background` with connection logs and graceful disconnect.
entries.reason: The service relies on text output, a foreground process and its own browser wrapper: it never passes --background.

entries.text: Improved macOS service startup, relaunch, and quit responsiveness.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu.

entries.text: Updated app icons for clearer artwork across platforms.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. App icons.

entries.text: Improved Wayland crash recovery on Linux and BSD.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. WebKit and Wayland crash recovery of the desktop app and the embedded browser.

entries.text: Fixed pasted callbacks and prompts for remote browser sign-in.
entries.reason: Pasted callbacks of --browser remote/manual. The service does not use this flow.

entries.text: Fixed legacy TLS configuration while preserving device identities.
entries.reason: gpclient v3 prints the legacy renegotiation text that makes the service retry with --fix-openssl.

entries.text: Fixed diagnostics when optional tools are unavailable.
entries.reason: The service does not run gpclient diagnostics.

entries.text: Fixed bundled macOS library paths and polished release notes in About.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu.

entries.text: Added `gpclient diagnostics` to collect system and client information for troubleshooting.
entries.reason: The service does not run gpclient diagnostics. Users can run it to collect data for a bug report.

entries.text: Recognized WebKit Wayland rendering crashes now trigger one retry with DMABUF disabled when opening the GUI, first-time setup, or embedded browser sign-in.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. WebKit and Wayland rendering of the desktop app.

entries.text: Improved desktop rendering with opaque windows to reduce transparency-related flickering on Linux and BSD.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Window rendering.

entries.text: Browser sign-in retries refresh authentication data, and repeated failures report both attempts instead of leaving the client waiting.
entries.reason: Retry logic inside the upstream browser sign-in. The service uses its own browser wrapper and the callback handler is guarded by contract item code-ensure-callback-handler.

entries.text: Cancelling startup or sign-in now stops pending desktop child processes and version checks.
entries.reason: Upstream-internal handling of cancellation of child processes. The service stops gpclient itself (see the terminate tests listed under 3.0.0 Improved cancellation).

entries.text: Fixed the bundled macOS CLI when launched through Homebrew.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu. Homebrew.

entries.text: Fixed browser sign-in failures leaving the CLI waiting without an error.
entries.reason: Upstream-internal error handling in gpauth. The service has its own browser wrapper and timeouts.

entries.text: Fixed first-time startup on Linux and BSD when no system keyring is available.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. First-time startup of the desktop app and its keyring.

entries.text: Improved tray menu behavior on Linux and BSD.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Tray menu.

entries.text: Added clearer results when manually checking for updates.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Update checks of the desktop app.

entries.text: Improved desktop dialogs, settings, keyboard focus, and Linux window controls.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Dialogs, settings and window controls.

entries.text: GP Connect for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later.
entries.reason: macOS only: this package is for Ubuntu.

entries.text: Support for internal gateways that authenticate your device without creating a VPN tunnel.
entries.reason: gpclient v3 can authenticate on an internal gateway without a tunnel. The service must show this as a failed activation, not as a connected VPN.

entries.text: More control over device compliance reports (HIP), including generated reports and custom scripts.
entries.reason: The profile setting hip-script passes a custom script as one --hip=<path> argument, after the service checks that only root can change it. gpclient generates reports itself when the service passes a bare --hip.

entries.text: Desktop update notifications, with in-app updates on macOS and links to new releases on Linux and BSD.
entries.reason: Desktop update notifications (gpgui). Updates of this package come from the apt repository.

entries.text: JSON log output for CLI integrations and automation.
entries.reason: The service relies on text output, a foreground process and its own browser wrapper: it never passes --log-format json.

entries.text: Refreshed the desktop connection view, gateway selection, and session details.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. The CLI gateway prompt that the service parses is guarded by contract items gateway-select-prompt, code-connect-portal and code-gateway-display.

entries.text: Improved browser sign-in, including opening your normal user's browser when the CLI runs with elevated privileges.
entries.reason: gpauth registers the globalprotectcallback handler with xdg-mime and fails without it, so the core package must depend on xdg-utils.

entries.text: Improved session expiry warnings and session extension when allowed by your VPN administrator.
entries.reason: Session expiry warnings and extension are not used by the service. A session that ends is handled as a disconnect.

entries.text: Updated license activation and recovery. Start the seven-day desktop trial by verifying your email address in the app.
entries.reason: License activation and trial are GUI features (gpgui).

entries.text: Improved cancellation, disconnect, and cached sign-in handling.
entries.reason: gpclient now logs out of the gateway on exit, so the service waits longer before SIGKILL.

entries.text: Improved desktop window and tray behavior across macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, and OpenBSD.
entries.reason: GUI only: the service does not run gpgui. Window and tray behavior; macOS and BSD.

entries.text: Improved package installation and desktop integration on Linux and BSD.
entries.reason: We build our own Debian packages. The desktop file we install is guarded by contract item desktop-exec.
